entries.description: Notice that Lavender Hill in Elk, California was sold to the Hare Krishna and is no longer women's land.
entries.raw_text: LAVENDER HILL (listed in VI,1) 1085 Greenwood Rd, Elk, CA 95432 - was sold last month to the Hare Krishna. So, it is NO LONGER WOMIN'S LAND, it is not a place for womin to visit, and we have lost it. It is sad for those of us who lived there, but good for those womin (many of them crones) who had money invested and wanted it out. Time to move on.
entries.notes: Not a listing; notice that the community has ended and the land was sold to the Hare Krishna. Land address taken from the street address in Elk, CA.

entries.description: Two radical lesbians currently living in Boston who own land in Frankfort, Maine, planning to build in 1983 or 1984 and eventually form a small lesbian community; seeking contact with older lesbians, artists, and lesbians with girl children.
entries.raw_text: REGGIE ODOM & EILEEN KENNEDY 86 Rossmore Rd #3, Jamaica Plain, MA 02130 (617)522-2472. If we haven't replied within 15 days, write us c/o General Delivery, Frankfort, ME 04438, where our land is located. We are two radical lesbians, ages 34 & 37, who are currently living in city with plans to build as soon as financially possible ('83 or '84). Eventually, want to form small lesbian community on land; especially interested in hearing from older lesbians, artists, dykes with girl children.
entries.notes: Community name taken from the opening names. Type is Private/Individual Land following the two-woman rule: two owners who do not yet live on the land ('currently living in city with plans to build...'). Num_residents is 0 because they do not live on the land yet. Land location is Frankfort, ME from 'Frankfort, ME 04438, where our land is located'; land_street_address is blank because General Delivery is not a street address. Accepted groups are Lesbian women ('radical lesbians', 'small lesbian community') and Girl children ('dykes with girl children'). Focus is Older women ('especially interested in hearing from older lesbians').
